rows.originalObservableContract: Selected-profile status call with no feature payload; Treasure entry consumes playerUid, allianceId, states before any claim; states merge by uuid.
rows.currentOperation: Current provider remains unavailable; current source has lower-level per-target Treasure info primitives only.
rows.missingObservableSemantics: Exact high-level provider acquisition/cache source for idle states and refresh policy.
rows.bridgeOwnedAdaptation: Profile ownership/generation fencing and DTO/cache shell may be modeled offline; no per-target transport invented.
rows.downstreamCapabilityRestriction: None from claim execution is required merely to represent/read an idle snapshot.
rows.futureLiveWitness: Optional only for provider acquisition/cache freshness; static high-level provider body would also settle.

rows.originalObservableContract: Polling starts only after claim result queued>0; 1s interval, <=1800 iterations; returned states merge each poll; missing batch or batch.state=running continues; present non-running batch stops.
rows.missingObservableSemantics: Provider controller/cache storage, full batch fields/counter transitions, terminal vocabulary, reset/reconnect/profile-change lifecycle.
rows.bridgeOwnedAdaptation: Profile-scoped batch owner/cancellation generation can be fail-closed in an offline controller shell.
rows.downstreamCapabilityRestriction: Real claim execution remains unavailable independently.
rows.terminalResultCorrelation: Batch terminal state is provider-owned status output; exact transport correlation to underlying per-target claims remains unrecovered.
rows.futureLiveWitness: Idle -> running -> terminal/reset plus profile-switch case, or protected high-level status/claim controller source.

rows.originalObservableContract: Host validates rows, calls prepareGhostPlunderTasks (5s), requires rows, matches by uuid, re-normalizes, then persists ghost:<uuid>.
rows.currentOperation: Current source row already has uuid, ownerServer, completionTime, taskExpireTime, stealList count; template has protectTime/stealMaxtimes; existing helper can derive plunderAt/counters.
rows.missingObservableSemantics: Exact protected preparer returned-row transformation/hydration/rejection semantics beyond host-visible postconditions.
rows.downstreamCapabilityRestriction: Terminal Ghost steal execution/correlation is unavailable, but that is later than preparation.
rows.terminalResultCorrelation: Not required to prepare/persist a row.
rows.futureLiveWitness: Not required to split capability. Needed only if exact preparer transformation must be proven dynamically; static preparer source would suffice.

rows.originalObservableContract: taskExpireTime may be <=0; when positive it must be > plunderAt.
rows.currentOperation: Current TaskInfo initializes taskExpireTime=0 and ParseData copies source value.
rows.missingObservableSemantics: No missing observable semantic for zero allowance; exact preparer may still add/alter expiry in some cases.
rows.bridgeOwnedAdaptation: Existing helper's unconditional >0 rule is conservative and not exact; follow-up may relax to exact host/current-domain rule.

rows.stage: Ghost direct terminal response Lua handler
rows.originalObservableContract: Current handler consumes errorCode and forwards same raw success table; manager consumes stealTimes/reward.
rows.currentOperation: No UUID/ownerServer/pointId read on direct success path.
rows.missingObservableSemantics: Complete raw server/direct response schema and stable terminal identity field.
rows.bridgeOwnedAdaptation: None may invent identity. A fail-closed adapter can preserve explicit identity if later source proves it.
rows.downstreamCapabilityRestriction: Scheduled Ghost execution remains fenced until safe correlation exists.
rows.terminalResultCorrelation: UNKNOWN; non-consumption is not schema absence.
rows.futureLiveWitness: Raw direct response identity/ordering, unless settled by static protobuf/managed receive source.

rows.originalObservableContract: Distinct push command; current push consumer reads serverId, pointId, playerInfo.
rows.currentOperation: Push carries location identity but consumer does not read task uuid.
rows.missingObservableSemantics: Whether push is paired with direct Ghost steal, uniqueness of serverId+pointId for durable task, ordering/duplicate behavior.
rows.downstreamCapabilityRestriction: Cannot use push as terminal completion yet.
rows.terminalResultCorrelation: Location identity exists; durable task correlation not established.
rows.futureLiveWitness: Static pairing/sequence source or future owner-authorized direct+push trace.

rows.originalObservableContract: NetworkManager owns FutureManager; FutureManager tracks futureId -> msgSendInfo and has send/receive timing methods; unique fuid literal present.
rows.currentOperation: Lua Ghost/SFS bodies do not directly call FutureManager; managed CIL tokens are modified and not fully name-resolved by current parser.
rows.missingObservableSemantics: Whether this fuid is injected into and surfaced from the Ghost direct raw response; whether it is unique/available to bridge result handling.
rows.bridgeOwnedAdaptation: Correlation adapter may accept explicit fuid later, but cannot synthesize it.
rows.downstreamCapabilityRestriction: Real Ghost execution remains unavailable until identity reaches the application result boundary.
rows.terminalResultCorrelation: Managed pending mechanism exists; end-to-end Ghost application correlation remains UNKNOWN.
rows.futureLiveWitness: Not necessarily live: a resolvable managed receive/protobuf source can settle. Otherwise future owner-authorized raw response witness.

readyImplementationCandidates.scope: Implement/test profile-scoped idle status DTO plus optional batch polling owner/generation retirement with injected inert provider snapshots. Do not implement real claim/status acquisition or invent batch counters.
Separate preparation capability from arm/result capability; evaluate existing one-to-one current-v22 normalizer as preparation-only adaptation. Keep public action/worker execution fences.
Relax preparation helper's unconditional positive taskExpireTime rule to allow zero/non-positive and require positive expiry > plunderAt, preserving positive ownerServer/timing/capacity guards.
Add inert correlation state/tests accepting only explicit uuid/fuid/point identity and rejecting absent, duplicate, ambiguous or mismatched results. Do not connect to real Ghost send/receive.
